beats.say: A 4-2 defeat knocked Mark Allen straight out of the Northern Ireland Open.
Fans expected a strong run on Tuesday 20 October, but Jordan Brown took the first-round victory.
So why did the match quickly slip away?
According to the BBC, Allen had not played since his World Championship semi-final loss to Wu Yize.
The BBC says Allen exits the tournament on his return following that loss to Brown.
Can Mark Allen bounce back to winning ways this season?
